masterJobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent portrait master for the Hemi desktop skin system. Edit target: the supplied poster image. Extract only its single illustrated character, preserving the exact recognizable face, expression, hairstyle, outfit, accessories and original rendering style. Remove every poster background, all lettering, logos, checkboxes and graphics. Produce one upright, clean, high-resolution portrait through the waist on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, fully opaque character interior, clean anti-aliased silhouette, about 5% transparent breathing room around the head and lateral hair. Keep the complete head and recognizable ornaments within the canvas. Modest original clothing. No UI, labels, border, floor, shadow backdrop, added objects or additional characters. Portrait composition suitable for a 270px-wide faint sidebar background, a theme-card crop and a 40px avatar. Keep the white/silver flowing hair, paired pale curved horns, pointed ears, purple eyes, gentle smile, lavender-and-white maid dress, purple bow and flower ornament, and the two hands clasped together exactly as in the reference. Preserve its delicate pastel anime linework and violet shading. Complete only the minimal missing outline necessary for an unclipped transparent half-body silhouette.

portraitPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Asset type: square transparent head-and-shoulders portrait used by a 102px Hemi theme card and the same 40px welcome avatar. Edit target: the provided transparent character master. Make a precise square portrait crop of this SAME character, keeping the original face, eyes, expression, hairstyle, outfit, colors, accessories and illustration/3D style unchanged. Frame the complete head, essential ears/horns/headband/ornaments, and upper shoulders, with the face centered and clearly recognizable at 40px. Preserve about 5% transparent space above the highest head ornament. Exclude lower torso and hands below shoulders; no new pose, no new expression, no outfit changes. Keep genuinely transparent RGBA outside the silhouette, clean neutral antialiased edges with NO colored poster fringe. Character interior must be fully opaque. No background, circle, border, decorative frame, text, label, logo, shadow backdrop or UI. A single portrait, no grid or contact sheet.
